title: conversion functions between integer types keep the low bits of a value the destination cannot hold
note: IEC 61131-3 leaves the result of an out-of-range integer conversion to the implementation; ZPLC defines it as the low bits of the source in the destination width (two's complement): 300 as SINT is 44, 70000 as INT is 4464, -1 as USINT is 255, as UINT 65535 and as UDINT 4294967295, 16#12345678 as WORD is 16#5678
